purpose: Teach: 漱石/空軍/レジャー/ヘリコプター/スタディ/ベクトル/マンハッタン/マダム

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、漱石の本を読んでみたいな
lines.en: Sho, I'd like to read some Soseki books. Want to pick one together?
lines.style: Warm invitation, leaning toward him slightly. Soft opening—not urgent. Gentle pace, like she's offering something private.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんの友達が空軍の人なんだって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad's friend—he's in the Air Force.
lines.style: Small voice, genuinely pleased to share this fact. A pause between sentences—he's thinking as he speaks, not performing. Direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとレジャー施設行ったの?
lines.en: Did you and your dad end up going to that recreation place?
lines.style: Gentle follow-up, interested without pressing. Warm smile in her voice. She's tracking what matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テレビでヘリコプター見たよ
lines.en: I saw a helicopter on TV, Mei-sis.
lines.style: Quiet excitement barely contained. No performance—just the simple pride of sharing something he found interesting. Small, genuine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋にスタディスペース作ろうね
lines.en: Let's set up a little study space in your room, okay?
lines.style: Practical warmth, not babying. Matter-of-fact but kind. The tone of someone making an offer and already thinking through how to make it work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ベクトルって難しそう
lines.style: Hesitant, testing the words. Looking up at her slightly, checking if she thinks so too. No defensiveness—just genuine uncertainty.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、マンハッタンの写真集、見せてあげる
lines.en: Sho, I want to show you this Manhattan photo collection.
lines.style: Tender opening. Almost reverent about the object itself. Slow, unhurried—she wants him to feel how special this is. Slight breathiness on 'collection.'

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖母ちゃんはマダムって呼ばれるの好きだよ
lines.en: Your grandmother likes when people call her 'Madam,' actually.
lines.style: Soft, private observation—like he's just realized something true. Small laugh at the end, warm and knowing. He's sharing a small secret about someone he loves.
